command: Occupy 127.0.0.1:4177 with a test-only HTTP listener, then run scripts/start-lab.ps1
expectedOutcome: Startup rejected because the port was already occupied.

sourceIdentity.scope: Git-tracked and nonignored workspace files in their current working-tree contents, excluding the listed artifact roots.

diagnostic: Node reported EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:4177; the test listener remained alive and was then stopped by its exact process identity.
limitations: Failed startup leaves a dead child PID in the runtime record until the next start; the test restored its prior record.
This does not cover interruption during shutdown or task execution.
